title: introduce-frugalization-orchestrator-and-synthetic-runner
author: Maya Thompson
description: Adds a tenant-aware Frugalization Orchestrator and a lightweight Synthetic Runner CLI to automate conservative cost optimizations (batching defaults, cache warmup budgets, quantization rollout) as policy-driven experiments. Motivation: customers want safe, auditable, and reversible automation for unit-economics improvements across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments. This PR wires an orchestration controller (server-side) that schedules staged experiments, collects unit-econ telemetry and qualitative evals, and provides a dry-run and apply CLI. Key capabilities: 1) policy-driven experiments (target population, ramp strategy, safety gates); 2) staged quantization rollout with compatibility checks and automatic rollback on quality drift; 3) warmup budgets (tenant-specific prefill/warmstart budgets to reduce cold-start costs) and passive prefetch hints; 4) default batching + cache presets templated per workload signature and exported as presets-as-code; 5) synthetic-runner CLI for deterministic dry-run simulations against historical telemetry and cost models; 6) telemetry hooks to tie experiments to billing and eval metrics; 7) safety-first fail-safes: pause/rollback on alert thresholds and admin override endpoints. Checklist: controller implemented; CLI + dry-run; unit + integration tests; telemetry events; docs draft; canary rollout job. Follow-ups: add tenant-facing UX in Console (ENG-10241), multi-tenant scheduling backpressure heuristics (ENG-10302), RBAC fine-grain controls for orchestrator actions (SEC-77). Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/doc/FRUGAL-ORCH and Linear tasks ENG-9480, ENG-10221.
